description.en: build multi-agent systems with A2A, MCP, and inter-agent communication
description.zh: 用 A2A、MCP 和跨 Agent 通信构建多 Agent 协作系统

goal.en: Orchestrate agents that talk to each other
goal.zh: 编排能互相协作的 Agent

outcome.en: Design multi-agent architectures where agents discover each other via A2A Agent Cards, communicate through standard protocols, and build on MCP for tool integration — the full stack for agent-to-agent collaboration.
outcome.zh: 设计多 Agent 架构——Agent 通过 A2A Agent Cards 互相发现，通过标准协议通信，基于 MCP 集成工具——Agent 间协作的完整技术栈。

reason.en: Build agents that discover, communicate, and collaborate using the A2A v1.0 protocol — Agent Cards, skill querying, and task streaming.
reason.zh: 用 A2A v1.0 协议构建能互相发现、通信和协作的 Agent——Agent Cards、技能查询和任务流式传输。

en: Create an Agent Card for my research agent
Discover agents that can handle PDF analysis
Send a long-running task to another agent with streaming
zh: 为我的研究 Agent 创建 Agent Card
发现能处理 PDF 分析的 Agent
向另一个 Agent 发送长时任务并流式获取结果

reason.en: Build MCP servers that give your agents new tools and data sources — the standard integration layer every agent needs.
reason.zh: 构建 MCP Server，为你的 Agent 提供新工具和数据源——每个 Agent 都需要的标准集成层。

en: Build an MCP server for my REST API
Add a database read tool to my MCP server
Create an MCP server from scratch
zh: 为我的 REST API 构建 MCP Server
给 MCP Server 添加数据库读取工具
从零创建一个 MCP Server

reason.en: Delegate implementation tasks to Claude Code or Codex while you focus on orchestration logic and agent architecture.
reason.zh: 把实现任务委托给 Claude Code 或 Codex，自己专注于编排逻辑和 Agent 架构。

en: Delegate the MCP server boilerplate to a coding agent
Have Codex scaffold the A2A transport layer
Run this integration test in a background agent
zh: 把 MCP Server 脚手架交给 coding agent
让 Codex 生成 A2A 传输层代码
在后台 agent 中运行这个集成测试
